node.title: Consumer-scoped F: the proof only needs F on TWO classical flat families
node.statement: F restricted to the families the consumers actually feed it: (a) coordinate-slice/fiber flats — direction spaces are shortened RS, hence MDS, hence dual distance w* provably LARGE: no sparse dual words exist and the spread/moment branch applies wholesale; (b) Hankel-pencil kernel flats — displacement rank <= 2: sparse dual words are governed by the structured-kernel theory (the #191 V^T D V identities). If the scope audit confirms consumers stay within (a) u (b), general F demotes from critical to nice-to-have and the many-sparse census narrows to displacement kernels.
node.attack_surface: GATE FIRST (QF.9): audit r2's fiber argument and imgfib's plane sections — verify every F-consumption lies in family (a) or (b); THEN (a) is classical MDS duality + the moment count, and (b) inherits #191; criticality rewiring only after the audit passes
node.falsifier: a consumer found feeding F a flat outside both families (the audit's negative outcome — then general F stays critical)
